selection: 2019-2021 rolling internal validation, fit preceding years only with20day label embargo; no 2022+ selection data
candidate_source: Existing206 KRX official candidates; prior price-quality eligibility retained
target: sign of actual5day total stock return; actual realized shock supplied retrospectively
features: pre-state plus ONE shock, vs pre-state alone; no future market return control
gate: >=45event observations, direction>=60%, gain>=3pp, positive gain in>=2years, coefficient sign same3years
ranking: Top6 pairs, distinct stocks, gate first then (accuracy-.5)+gain. If fewer pass, remaining are explicitly exploratory, not validated selections
holdout: 2023-2026 excluded from selection, but previously reused overall research; not independent blind
